title: Review an exact coding action and its consent scope

fields.label: Exact operation
fields.hint: Inspectable arguments, target, policy source and side effects

fields.label: Remember this decision

fields.label: Personal project or preset rule
fields.value: Same project for me / same agent preset for me
fields.hint: Principal and current policy version remain bound

fields.label: Sensitive or credential-like content
fields.hint: No remembered rule and no review-model disclosure

rows.name: Hard host restriction
rows.value: Sandbox, current grants and matching denies

notice: Approving this exact effect grants no broader filesystem, network or run-budget permission. A conversation rule ends on this device session’s expiry.

title: Inspect, edit or revoke your exact action policy

fields.label: Search coding policies
fields.hint: Bound scope and policy source remain inspectable

fields.label: Coding decision
fields.hint: Matching denies override every remembered allow

fields.label: Expires after seconds
fields.hint: Bounded expiry; edit preserves matcher and binding

fields.label: Current policy revision
fields.hint: CAS mutation requires this inspected version

notice: Editing changes effect or bounded expiry only. It cannot expand the exact target, matcher, sandbox or principal. Revoke is immediate; stale consent needs fresh approval.

title: A stale or sensitive action needs a fresh decision

fields.label: Policy changed
fields.hint: Refresh before applying the inspected revision

fields.label: Current authority
fields.hint: Previous remembered consent is not reusable

fields.label: Sensitive content
fields.hint: Human once-only decision; zero reviewer calls

fields.label: Revoked rule
fields.value: No further effect under this consent
fields.hint: The next matching action pauses for fresh consent

notice: No timeout becomes consent. Hard restrictions and current denies still win; a rule cannot override a removed grant or locked originating device session.

title: Configure authoritative organizations and identity groups

fields.label: Group and organization
fields.hint: New group or enrolled group; organization is explicit

fields.label: Group host role
fields.hint: Only administrator mappings grant host authority

fields.label: Trusted host execution
fields.hint: Shared host OS user; does not claim tenant isolation

fields.label: Verified provider mapping
fields.value: Configured issuer · exact groups claim value
fields.hint: Only fresh verified issuer evidence enrolls members

notice: User-controlled display names or untrusted group claims grant nothing. Removing membership or changing a role/grant revokes affected device sessions.

title: Review live memberships and exact project grants

fields.label: Principal and source
fields.hint: Provider and manual membership provenance stay distinct

fields.label: Membership expires in days
fields.hint: Bounded 1–90 days; removal revokes affected sessions

fields.label: Execution project
fields.hint: Groups outside this project cannot acquire its authority

fields.label: Allowed action scopes
fields.hint: Action-specific project grants; no implied shell permission

rows.name: Member removal
rows.status: Sign in again for current authority

notice: Expiry and removal are checked at the host on every effect. Provider mappings require configured verified claims; a stale token cannot preserve removed access.

title: Access changed elsewhere — preserve the draft and inspect

fields.label: Unsaved group draft
fields.hint: A changed current revision cannot overwrite this draft

fields.label: Reviewed current revision
fields.value: Version 5 · current role and trusted execution
fields.hint: Compare before keep-draft continuation

fields.label: Live membership state
fields.hint: Affected sessions lost authority immediately

fields.label: Current session
fields.hint: No stale response reopens administrator controls

notice: Refresh only reads current inventory. Choosing to keep your draft acknowledges the inspected revision; grants remain enforced server-side.

title: Set audit retention with explicit permanent-removal consent

fields.label: Keep records for days
fields.hint: Allowed 1–3650 days

fields.label: Maximum audit bytes
fields.hint: Bounded 65536–67108864 bytes

fields.label: Maximum audit records
fields.hint: Bounded 100–100000 metadata records

fields.label: Removal acknowledgement
fields.value: I understand applying retention removes older records
fields.hint: Required before save-and-prune or prune-saved-limits

rows.name: Audit content
rows.status: No passwords, cookies or captured output

notice: Saving limits immediately prunes older or excess records. Removal is permanent and the retention operation is itself recorded in the audit.

title: Inspect the audit retention result

fields.label: Removed records
fields.hint: Actual bounded operation count shown after completion

fields.label: Retained records and bytes
fields.hint: Confirmed response; no optimistic success

fields.label: Saved policy
fields.hint: The current saved policy is inspectable

fields.label: Changed or locked identity
fields.hint: Fresh observation required after unlock

notice: Result counts are illustrative design data; runtime displays the actual host response. A late response from a locked or changed account is ignored.

title: Manage model favorites without changing any session

fields.label: Model search
fields.hint: Models manager search filters current catalogs

fields.label: Installed engine catalog
fields.hint: No paid provider inference and no automatic account fallback

fields.label: Account model favorite
fields.hint: Per-principal device preference shared across windows

fields.label: Unavailable favorite
fields.value: Catalog not loaded or model unavailable
fields.hint: Retain clearly labelled entry or remove it

notice: Favorites help navigation only. Catalog changes and favorites never retarget a conversation or restart active work; errors preserve the current selection.

title: Supervise one shared parent and child execution pool

fields.label: Root task and grant
fields.hint: The same immutable pool is visible on each child

fields.label: Reserved tool calls
fields.hint: Exact retries reuse reservations; parallel children cannot multiply allowance

fields.label: Summed active worker time
fields.hint: Parent, child, context and provider planning consume the same pool

fields.label: Human approval waits
fields.hint: Individual task ceilings and fan-out limits still apply

notice: This measures reserved tool calls and summed active execution seconds. It does not estimate tokens or billed costs. Cancelling preserves consumed reservations and actual checkpoints.

title: Approve a versioned shared budget extension

fields.label: Inspected shared version
fields.hint: Decision, grant and resumable intent commit atomically

fields.label: Total shared tool-call ceiling
fields.hint: Must exceed already reserved calls; completed effects remain

fields.label: Fresh shared active seconds
fields.hint: Explicit fresh summed parent/child time allowance

fields.label: Other paused task
fields.value: Continue within the same new grant
fields.hint: Cannot reset the meter or raise the shared ceiling twice

notice: Approval of a budget never approves a tool effect or plan. Every parked task needs explicit continuation; the same exact tool reservation is not charged twice.

title: Restart after an approved grant — continue without a second reset

fields.label: Durable approved receipt
fields.hint: Original approval and grant version are retained

fields.label: Continue within approved budget
fields.hint: Does not reset time or increase tool-call ceiling

fields.label: Uncertain live execution
fields.hint: Fresh explicit renewal required; partial effects need inspection

fields.label: Exact saved batch
fields.value: Canonical pending calls and completed checkpoints
fields.hint: No automatic tool replay

rows.name: Host restart
rows.value: No provider or tool starts until confirmation

notice: If a running lease was lost, the host cannot assume unused time. A committed approval with no worker launch gets an explicit continue decision inside its existing grant.

title: Parallel planning exhausted the shared allowance

fields.label: Planning phase
fields.value: Saved task context and upload references
fields.hint: Both child plans share the parent pool before provider work

fields.label: Provider planning request
fields.hint: No unaccounted child planning continues

fields.label: Explicit renewal
fields.hint: A budget grant cannot bypass plan approval

fields.label: Plan approval
fields.hint: No child execution effect before its plan is approved

notice: Human wait is paused. Renewal resumes the preserved planning phase, then presents a new plan for approval; it never silently starts coding after a time grant.
